subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: Position, directions and 2D shapes
source.subtopic: Language of position: in front of, behind, left, right, up, down, next to, on top of

show.line: My left hand, my right hand. The cat is on the left. The dog is on the right!

rounds.prompt: Which animal is on the left?
rounds.praise: Yes! The cat is on the left.

rounds.prompt: Where is the ball? Tap the picture where the ball is behind the box.
rounds.praise: Yes! The ball is behind the box.

rounds.prompt: Look. Is the bird on top of the tree or under the tree?
Which hand is the right hand?
rounds.praise: Yes! That is the right hand.

rounds.prompt: Which child is standing next to the teacher?
rounds.praise: Yes! Next to means right beside.

rounds.story: Lebo walks. The shop is on her left. The park is on her right. What is on her right?
rounds.praise: The park! It is on her right.

hints: Hold up your hands. Your left hand makes an L shape with its thumb.
In front means you can see it first. Behind means it is hidden at the back.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say where the dog is.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The dog is on the left!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The dog is on the right. The cat is on the left.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Cat on the left, dog on the right!

parent_line: Can use left, right, in front of, behind, next to and on top of.
